  3. <fidel-sign-term>

<fidel-sign-term>

A tech word with its sign. The word becomes a button that opens a dialog with a muted, looping sign-language clip and the meaning in English and Amharic.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Deaf learners, for whom written English or Amharic is often a second language.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት። The clip for "log in" is a test pattern, not a real sign. "server" shows what a learner sees when no sign is recorded yet.

To open your account, you log in. Your lessons are kept on a server.

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-sign-term term="login" sign="/media/signs/login.webm" poster="/media/signs/login.jpg"
                 meaning-en="Entering your name and password to open your account."
                 meaning-am="ስምዎንና የይለፍ ቃልዎን አስገብተው መለያዎን መክፈት።">login</fidel-sign-term>

Source: player/src/components/c/sign-term.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-sign-term>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
termtextthe text insideThe word.
signURL (WebM or MP4)noneThe sign-language clip (downloaded only when the dialog opens).
posterURLnoneA still picture of the sign.
meaning-en, meaning-amtextnonePlain-language meaning.
sign-placeholderbooleanoffThe clip is a stand-in: the dialog says "Placeholder clip".
glossaryURLnoneA glossary { terms: [{ en, sign, meaning_en, meaning_am }] }; attributes win.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-sign-term>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-sign-term-open{ term }The dialog opened.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Enter or Space on the word opens the dialog; Play/Pause and Slower (0.5×) are buttons.
  • Escape closes the dialog and returns focus to the word.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.2.1 Audio-only and Video-only: The clip is video-only; its written meaning is the alternative.
  • 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide: The looping clip has a Pause button and does not start by itself with reduced motion.
  • 3.1.3 Unusual Words (AAA): A meaning and a sign for tech words.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
